subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)
body:
From: Anika Desai <anikad@google.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:18 AM PST
Subject: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the submission. Our automated validation + reviewer checks flagged a few items that need to be updated before we can proceed:

1) Required policy links
- Privacy policy URL is missing in the “Support & legal” section.
- Terms of service URL is missing.
- Data processing / data use statement is required (DPA link is acceptable).

2) Support contact requirements
- A support email address must be included in the listing and must resolve to a monitored inbox.
- Support URL must be a public link (no login required).

3) Deployment / onboarding instructions
- “How to get started” needs explicit steps for buyers who purchase via Marketplace, including:
  - where entitlements appear
  - how they link purchase to their Redwood org
  - expected activation time
  - what info support needs to debug (order id / billing account / project id)

4) Security / compliance language
- Please avoid “certified” language unless you are referencing an actual certification issued by an accredited body.
- If you reference SOC 2 / ISO posture, include neutral language (e.g., “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA”).

Once updated, please resubmit and reply to this email with the new submission timestamp.

Best,
Anika
Cloud Marketplace Partner Engineering


---

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Desai <anikad@google.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 11:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)

Hi Anika,

Understood — thank you for the detailed list.

Quick clarifying questions so we can get this right on the resubmission:

1) For the DPA/data use requirement: is a public DPA page sufficient, or do you need a “data use” paragraph embedded directly in the listing text as well?

2) Support URL: we can provide a public Marketplace onboarding + troubleshooting page (no login). Is that acceptable vs. a general support portal?

3) “How to get started”: we’ll include step-by-step Marketplace purchase → entitlement → Redwood org linking. Do you prefer this as a single block in the listing description, or a link to our docs page plus a shorter summary in the listing?

We’ll remove any “certified” wording and align to your SOC2/ISO guidance.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Marketing (Exec Sponsor), Redwood Inference


---

From: Anika Desai <anikad@google.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 12:27 PM PST
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)

Hi Camila,

Answers below:

1) DPA/data use: A public DPA page is sufficient as the “data processing” link. You can optionally add a short “Data handling” paragraph in the listing, but the link is the requirement.

2) Support URL: A public onboarding + troubleshooting page is fine (no login). Please include support email as well.

3) Getting started: We recommend a short summary in the listing (3–6 steps) plus a link to your docs for full details.

Also, please ensure the Terms and Privacy links are reachable without redirects that require geolocation or cookie acceptance to proceed.

Best,
Anika


---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 2:10 PM PST
Subject: Fwd: GCP validation list — proposed updates

Camila —

I pulled together the draft edits we should make to comply with Anika’s points. Highlights:

- Listing: add Support & legal section with 4 links (Terms, Privacy, DPA, Security overview) + support@redwoodinference.com
- Replace “SOC 2 certified” → “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA”
- Add “Getting started (Marketplace buyers)” steps:
  1) Purchase in Marketplace
  2) Receive entitlement activation (typically <15 min; may take up to 60)
  3) Sign in to Redwood Console
  4) Link your GCP billing account/project to your Redwood org
  5) Confirm entitlement in Console → Billing → Cloud Marketplace
  6) Run a validation request (curl/SDK) and confirm usage appears

Elliot is drafting the public docs page that matches this.

If you’re aligned, I’ll update the listing copy in the portal today and route to you for final check.

—Soojin


---

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 9:05 AM PST
Subject: GCP Marketplace: public docs link + support details (ready)

Camila,

Draft public page is ready and does not require login:

- https://redwoodinference.com/docs/billing/gcp-marketplace

Includes:
- purchase → entitlement → org linking flow
- expected timing + what to do if activation is delayed
- what to send support (GCP billing account ID, project ID, Marketplace order/entitlement ID, Redwood org slug)
- region notes + common validation/provisioning error (region mismatch)

Support contacts included:
- support@redwoodinference.com
- security@redwoodinference.com (for security packet requests)

Talia: can you sanity-check the entitlement timing language (<15 min typical / up to 60) against what Engineering/SRE wants us to promise? I wrote it as “typical” + “may take longer during initial rollout.”

Thanks,
Elliot
Docs Lead, Redwood Inference


---

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Desai <anikad@google.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 3:44 PM PST
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)

Hi Anika,

We’ve made the requested updates and are ready to resubmit.

Changes applied:
- Added public links:
  - Terms: https://redwoodinference.com/legal/terms
  - Privacy: https://redwoodinference.com/legal/privacy
  - DPA: https://redwoodinference.com/legal/dpa
  - Security overview: https://redwoodinference.com/security
- Added support contact details:
  - support@redwoodinference.com
  - Public onboarding/troubleshooting: https://redwoodinference.com/docs/billing/gcp-marketplace
- Updated “Getting started” section with 6-step summary + link to docs
- Removed “certified” language; now states: “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA”

We’re submitting the revised listing now; I’ll reply with the submission timestamp once it’s confirmed in the portal.

Best,
Camila

Attachment: Redwood_Inference_GCP_Marketplace_Listing_Updates_v3.pdf (PDF summary of changes)

From: Anika Desai <anikad@google.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2025 at 4:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — Cloud Marketplace listing validation errors + required policy links (resubmission)

Hi Camila,

Thanks — the links are accessible and the revised copy resolves the validation errors we saw.

Next steps:
1) Please resubmit in Partner Portal.
2) Reply here with the resubmission timestamp and (if available) the new submission/revision ID.
3) Our reviewer will re-run checks; if anything else comes up it will be limited to formatting (e.g., section headings) rather than missing requirements.

One note: in the listing, please ensure the support email appears as plain text (not only embedded in an image/screenshot).

Best,
Anika
Cloud Marketplace Partner Engineering
